shared_elements: a linear series of repeated small units (crew strokes / glyph blocks)
schematic, non-naturalistic marking of the surface
justification: The only correspondence is the wholly generic device of a row of repeated small schematic units — the hook-shaped crew strokes above the boat hull in A and the paired rectangular sign-blocks in B. Otherwise the content is unrelated: A shows a single large boat with upcurved prow and stern plus a few small figures and animal-like marks scattered on an open field, while B shows nothing but dense vertical columns of rounded, cartouche-like signs covering the whole surface, with no vessel, figure or scene at all.
